elevate.move: Make the spine actually print: as each section enters, its ticket line types onto the left strip in DM Mono with a short stepped paper-feed nudge, and every pick in the estimator, quiz or service rows prints a new line onto the strip where the visitor is; reduced motion shows all lines pre-printed, so the 25/50/75 frames show a receipt growing.

Give the spine a rhythm: collapse it to a thin perforated edge (~24px) in bands that need width (#reviews, #crew), and widen it into a full ticket only where it carries data (price, list, quiz, hours, form), so the same left column stops repeating and the dead paper disappears.
